roles.title: Customer Success Engineer
highlights: Employee #13. Owned the customer experience through hypergrowth: 5k → 130k+ paying customers, ARR up 15x, and tickets 200 → 1,500+/week
Built an AI support agent from scratch (intent, classification, tool use, and replies) with custom evals and benchmarks; resolves ~25% of conversations
Cut resolution time by 70% and held first-response SLAs while ticket volume grew 7x, consistently at 2–4x the throughput of peer CSEs
Closed the loop with Engineering through recurring deep dives, demos, and Feedback Friday, a weekly customer-feedback newsletter
Shipped product code directly (rate-limit automation and support tooling) and helped hire and onboard the support team

Owned ~80% of CS-covered accounts ($40M+ ARR) at 115% team NRR, 130% on my own book
Doubled Scale segment coverage with no added headcount through webinar programs and automation
Built Next.js automations and Gong, Planhat, Slack, and Zendesk integrations saving 2,000+ team hours a year
Automated account assignment with suggestions by region and book load, replacing a manual, Director-gated process
